incidents.name: ATK getPrice spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: The ATK token's getPrice() returns the ATK/BUSDT pair's live reserve ratio, and the staking contract's claimReward() sizes its payout from it, so a flash loan moved the price and inflated the reward.

sources.ref: onchain review: ATK 0x9cb928bf50ed220ac8f703bce35be5ce7f56c99c created 2022-10-04T05:15:26Z by 0x3ed61a183ba5a60040c65917661f9a966a52e0ee, unrelated to attack sender 0x3df6cd58716d22855afb3b828f82f10708afbb4f; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 127,677.36 USDT left the staking contract 0xd228faee4f73a73fcc73b6d9a1bd25ee1d6ee611 to the attacker in this transaction. Boundary row: the reward logic behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price getPrice() reads.
